question: Which of the following rivers flows into the Arabian Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rivers that flow into the **Arabian Sea are Tapi, Narmada, Sindhu, Purna, and Sabarmati**. 
 
• **Narmada is also called Reva **and is located in** Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat.**
 
• It is called the lifeline of **Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh as it contributes largely **to both states in several ways.
 
• The river rises from the** Amarkantak plateau in Madhya Pradesh and flows westwards**.
 
• It has a length of **1312 kilometres and drains into the Arabian Sea**.
 
• It is the** longest west flowing river and is among the only three major rivers of Peninsular India** along with the Tapti River and Mahi river.
 
• **Narmada river **does not form any delta.
